name: General of Atlantis
text: This card's name becomes "Umi" while in the Monster Zone. You can only use each of the following effects of "General of Atlantis" once per turn. You can discard this card; add 1 Spell/Trap that mentions "Atlantis, City of the Sea Dragon" from your Deck to your hand. If this card is in your GY and you control "Umi": You can Special Summon this card.
